en.headline: Labour Department files 25 charges over Wang Fuk Court worker deaths
en.dek: Prosecutions under the Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance target duty holders over the November fire that killed five contractor staff at the Tai Po estate.
body: The Labour Department said on Wednesday that it has brought 25 charges against duty holders linked to the building repair works at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po, where a fire on 26 November last year killed five contractor staff.

A department spokesman said that, after consulting the Department of Justice, the Labour Department had at this stage begun prosecutions by way of indictment under the Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance. The defendants include a contractor, a project consultant and an individual, and the charges concern alleged contraventions of the ordinance’s general duty provisions.

The spokesman said the department does not tolerate breaches of occupational safety and health legislation and will enforce the law strictly to protect employees. The Buildings Department separately announced on Wednesday that it had laid 259 charges against two companies and four people over the same renovation works, an action already reported.

zh.headline: 勞工處就宏福苑五名工友遇難提25項檢控
zh.dek: 勞工處經徵詢律政司後，根據《工廠及工業經營條例》向承建商、工程顧問及個別人士提出公訴，涉去年11月大埔宏福苑維修地盤火警。
body: 勞工處周三表示，就去年11月26日大埔宏福苑樓宇修葺工程地盤火警導致五名工程承建商人員遇難，已向相關持責者提出共25項檢控。
發言人指，經徵詢律政司意見後，處方現階段根據《工廠及工業經營條例》循公訴程序，向包括承建商、工程顧問及個別人士在內的持責者，就涉嫌違反條例下的一般責任條文提出檢控。
發言人強調，勞工處絕不容忍違反職業安全及健康法例的行為，定必嚴厲執法以保障僅員。同日屋宇署亦就同一維修工程向兩間公司及四名人士提出259項檢控，有關檢控較早前已報道。
